name: Pabilo Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: pabilo

sections.description:
Pabilo Payment Gateway lets WooCommerce stores accept payments from major Venezuelan banks through a simple, verified flow.

This plugin connects your store to the Pabilo payment service. When you configure your API key, you consent to sending order data (amount, description, order ID) to Pabilo to generate payment links and verify transactions. See Pabilo Terms of Use for data handling details.

Configure your API key, choose the bank account to receive funds, and start accepting:

  • Pago Móvil (mobile payments)
  • Bank transfers

Supported banks include Banco de Venezuela, Mercantil, Banesco, Provincial, and other banks supported by Pabilo.

The plugin verifies payments automatically via webhooks and the Pabilo API. When the customer retries payment, a compatible pending link is verified and reused. Changes to the order total update that link through the API. Expired links or changes to the receiving bank or order currency require a new link; temporary API errors do not create duplicates.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/pabilo-payment-gateway-for-woocommerce, or install via the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Pabilo Payment Gateway to configure.
  4. Enter your API Key from your Pabilo dashboard.
  5. Select the bank account where you want to receive funds.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Pabilo account?

Yes. Sign up at pabilo.app to get your API credentials.

Which banks are supported?

The plugin supports transfers and Pago Móvil from major Venezuelan banks, including Banco de Venezuela, Mercantil, Banesco, and Provincial.

Which currency does the payment link use?

The link uses the WooCommerce order currency: USD, EUR, USDT or Venezuelan bolívares. The WooCommerce code VES is sent as VEF, the equivalent code expected by the Pabilo API. The plugin sends the original order amount; Pabilo manages conversion into the receiving account settlement currency. The plugin does not add a currency selector. For USDT, the order currency must already be USDT through your existing currency configuration.

Why can the bank list load while payment link creation is rejected?

Reading bank accounts and creating payment links require different access. Use the manual Pabilo access check in the gateway settings to identify authentication and route restrictions. The integration needs permission to create links for the selected receiving account. The check uses the saved key and an empty request that cannot create a link; reaching the route does not validate the bank account or guarantee a real checkout payment.
sections.changelog:
1.0.8

  • Fix: Record HTTP status and a safe API reason in private order notes when link creation fails.
  • Feature: Add a manual administrator access check without generating payment links.
  • Privacy: Keep credentials, personal data and raw API responses out of diagnostics.

1.0.7

  • Fix: Send the order currency explicitly and verify link amounts, retries and every webhook state.
  • Fix: Include runtime checkout JavaScript in release packages; keep directory artwork separate.
  • Fix: Render payment labels safely in the block checkout and editor.
  • Fix: Isolate checkout scripts and register the correct versioned asset.
  • Fix: Validate bank account configuration and show actionable connection errors.

1.0.6

  • Fix: Prevent fatal error in filemtime when JS build file is missing.
  • Compatibility: Tested up to WordPress 7.0.

1.0.5

  • Feature: Reuse existing payment link when the customer goes back and clicks Pay again (avoids duplicate payment links).
  • Feature: When the order total changes (e.g. cart edited), update the same link via Pabilo PATCH API instead of creating a new one.

1.0.4

  • Feature: Support for WooCommerce Blocks Checkout (new checkout experience).
  • Security: Enhanced webhook verification (Payment Link ID check).
  • Security: Validate payment link ownership against store admin account.
  • Fix: Prevented fatal error in Blocks checkout during payment processing.

1.0.3

  • Verify webhook with Pabilo API before marking order paid (security).
  • WordPress.org compatibility: Requires Plugins, Requires PHP, Tested up to 6.9.
  • Privacy and Terms of Use documentation.

1.0.2

  • Full Spanish translation.
  • Pago Móvil and bank transfer messaging.

1.0.1

  • Description and icon improvements.
  • Webhook verification logic updated.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
